page.overview:
Who is Captain Banana Guard?

Captain Banana Guard is a character who was first seen in "One Last Job". He was previously mentioned, however, by Princess Bubblegum in "Princess Cookie". Captain Banana Guard was, as his name suggests, the captain of the Banana Guards, although he was ultimately replaced by Root Beer Guy.

Captain Banana Guard resembles a regular Banana Guard, with a few differences. He has a chocolate mustache, and his head is topped with whipped cream instead of sugar cubes. He seems to be older than other guards, as indicated by his voice, his mustache, and his more faded color scheme.
